Chiikawa official manga style educational illustration, 4:3, explaining gcloud configuration management. === TITLE === "gcloud 配置管理" — floating typography, NOT anchored to any solid band or box; coral-pink (#FF8E9E) bold rounded font with White Outer Glow and Subtle Drop Shadow for legibility on light backgrounds; surrounded by small pastel flowers, twinkling stars, and tiny hearts woven naturally into the scene === SCENE & LAYOUT === Layout: Step-by-step configuration flow Background: Soft gradient cream (#FFF8E7) to sky-blue (#B0E2FF), minimal scattered cloud shapes === MAIN CONTENT === Use official Chiikawa characters such as Chiikawa / Hachiware / Usagi with clearly different appearances and roles [CONTENT_SECTION_1] Character: Chiikawa (吉伊), the small white marshmallow - Anxiously typing on a miniature laptop - Laptop displays command prompt Visual: A small cloud representing the development environment taking shape Label: "gcloud config configurations create dev" — inside a semi-transparent cloud-like blob (marshmallow-soft aesthetic, pure white at 70–80% opacity, NO hard border, soft edges blending into the background) Dialogue: "好紧张… (So nervous...)" [CONTENT_SECTION_2] Character: Hachiware (小八), the blue-marked cat - Holding a clipboard with settings listed - Pointing to a specific setting with a pen Visual: A settings panel with account, project, and region fields Label: "set account/project/region" — inside a semi-transparent cloud-like blob (marshmallow-soft aesthetic, pure white at 70–80% opacity, NO hard border, soft edges blending into the background) Dialogue: "要设置这些参数哦! (Activate the development environment!)" [CONTENT_SECTION_6] Character: Usagi (乌萨奇), the energetic rabbit - Giving a thumbs-up enthusiastically - The background sparkles around him Visual: A "prod" badge appearing on the production environment cloud Label: "configurations activate prod" — inside a semi-transparent cloud-like blob (marshmallow-soft aesthetic, pure white at 70–80% opacity, NO hard border, soft edges blending into the background) Dialogue: "やったー！(Yattaaa!)" All commands apply to the prod project)" === KEY CONCEPTS === 3 floating info boxes; each box uses a semi-transparent cloud-like blob background (marshmallow-soft, pure white at 70–80% opacity, no hard border), text in dark charcoal (#2D2D2D), medium-weight sans-serif: Box 1: "gcloud config configurations create: 创建新的配置 (Create a new configuration)" Box 2: "set account/project/region: 设置账户、项目和区域 (Set account, project, and region)" Box 3: "configurations activate: 激活特定配置 (Activate a specific configuration)" === CHIIKAWA STYLE === Official Chiikawa aesthetic: round bodies, large sparkly eyes, pink blush marks, tiny limbs, super deformed proportions, gentle line art === TEXT RENDERING === Typography rules (CRITICAL — apply to every label, title, and annotation): - Title: floating typography with White Outer Glow or Subtle Drop Shadow — NO solid background band; title integrates naturally into the illustrated scene with decorative Chiikawa elements around it - All labels placed inside semi-transparent cloud-like blobs (marshmallow-soft, pure white at 70–80% opacity, no hard borders) — soft edges naturally blend into the illustrated background - Font: bold (600–700) rounded sans-serif for title; medium-weight (500–600) for labels; NO thin, cursive, or brush-stroke fonts - Text color: dark charcoal (#2D2D2D) on the light blob background; minimum contrast 4.5:1 - Chinese characters: every stroke and radical must be Fully Formed and Vector-style clarity — no hairline breaks, no missing components, no pixelation - Smooth anti-aliased edges; absolutely NO cracked, fragmented, or glitchy strokes === MOOD === Helpful, educational, cute but informative Quality: High-quality Chiikawa illustration, clear visual hierarchy, for documentation
